test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form.

"A decision will have been taken by the committee."

options.text: The committee will take a decision.
The Committee will have taken a decision
The committee has taken a decision.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "A decision will have been taken by the committee."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the committee" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "will have been taken" to "will have taken" (future perfect active).
 
• Ensure the object "a decision" remains after the verb for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The committee will have taken a decision."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The committee will take a decision." – Incorrect tense (future simple active).
 
• **Option 3: **"The committee took a decision." – Incorrect tense (past simple active).
 
• **Option 4: **"The committee has taken a decision." – Incorrect tense (present perfect active).
